name: Avapritinib (Advanced Systemic Mastocytosis, KIT D816V)
disease: Advanced systemic mastocytosis (ASM, SM-AHN, mast cell leukemia)
histology: advanced systemic mastocytosis: aggressive SM (ASM), SM with an associated hematologic neoplasm (SM-AHN), or mast cell leukemia (MCL)

biomarkers.KIT: D816V mutation - the driver of the vast majority of SM and the target of avapritinib (a potent selective KIT D816V inhibitor)
biomarkers.imatinibGuard: imatinib is INEFFECTIVE against KIT D816V; imatinib is reserved for KIT D816V-mutation-negative or unknown SM (or FIP1L1::PDGFRA-associated disease). False-negative guard: do not substitute imatinib for a D816V-positive patient.
biomarkers.note: Avapritinib is FDA-approved for indolent SM and for advanced SM (ASM, SM-AHN, MCL). It is a KIT D816V-selective inhibitor. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Systemic Mastocytosis, SM-6 (ASM), SM-7/SM-8 (SM-AHN), SM-9 (MCL), and the Discussion (PATHFINDER trial).

lineOfTherapy: preferred systemic therapy for advanced SM (ASM, SM-AHN, MCL) in patients with platelets >= 50 x 10^9/L

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: advanced systemic mastocytosis (ASM, SM-AHN with SM component requiring prioritization, or MCL)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, SM-6 (Treatment for Aggressive Systemic Mastocytosis: Preferred - Avapritinib); SM-7 (SM-AHN); SM-9 (MCL)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: platelet count >= 50 x 10^9/L (avapritinib is not recommended for platelets < 50 x 10^9/L due to intracranial bleeding risk)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, SM-6 footnote t (Avapritinib is not recommended for patients with platelet counts < 50 x 10^9/L); masto lines 659, 2854

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: KIT D816V mutation (typical driver; avapritinib is D816V-selective). Efficacy was established irrespective of prior therapy or S/A/R mutation status
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v3.2026, Discussion MS-17/MS-18 (avapritinib is a potent selective KIT D816V inhibitor); DeVita 12th ed. line 22631 (KIT D816V is imatinib-resistant)

drugs.name: Avapritinib

provenance.locator: Discussion MS-18 (PATHFINDER: advanced SM treated with avapritinib at a starting dose of 200 mg once daily); SM-6 (Preferred: Avapritinib if platelets >= 50 x 10^9/L); masto line 2839

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Systemic Mastocytosis v3.2026, Discussion MS-18 (PATHFINDER, avapritinib 200 mg once daily starting dose for ADVANCED SM) and SM-6/SM-7/SM-9 (Preferred). Given continuously PO once daily (represented as days 1 to 28). NOTE - the INDOLENT SM dose is different: 25 mg once daily (PIONEER trial, MS-17, masto line 2817); the 200 mg dose modeled here is specific to ADVANCED SM. Platelet-count gate: not recommended if platelets < 50 x 10^9/L (SM-6 footnote t) because of intracranial-bleeding risk. Refer to prescribing information for dose modifications (SM-6 footnote u). No ISMP tall-man form for avapritinib.

supportiveCare: Verify platelet count >= 50 x 10^9/L before and during therapy; hold/reduce and reassess for intracranial-bleeding risk if severe thrombocytopenia develops (SM-6 footnote t).

Continuous daily oral dosing with no defined cycle count; continue until progression, intolerance, or loss of response; consider evaluation for allogeneic HCT on adequate response in eligible SM-AHN/MCL.
Cognitive-effect and intracranial-hemorrhage counseling per prescribing information.

monitoring: CBC/platelets (thrombocytopenia; intracranial-bleeding risk if platelets < 50 x 10^9/L)
serum tryptase, bone marrow mast cell burden, and KIT D816V variant allele fraction (disease-burden response)
spleen volume / organomegaly and SM-related organ damage (C-findings)
neurocognitive assessment and signs of intracranial hemorrhage

doseModificationRules.text: Avapritinib is not recommended for platelets < 50 x 10^9/L (SM-6 footnote t); hold/reduce per prescribing information and reassess intracranial-bleeding risk. Obtain clinical review.

doseModificationRules.condition: intracranial hemorrhage or new neurocognitive changes
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and evaluate; manage per prescribing information (SM-6 footnote u).

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 22631 (KIT D816V is an imatinib-resistant mutation - basis for using a D816V-selective inhibitor rather than imatinib in D816V-positive SM)

guideline.locator: SM-6 (ASM: Preferred - Avapritinib if platelets >= 50 x 10^9/L, or Midostaurin; footnotes t/u); SM-7/SM-8 (SM-AHN); SM-9 (MCL); Discussion MS-17/MS-18 (avapritinib KIT D816V-selective; advanced-SM starting dose 200 mg once daily, PATHFINDER; indolent-SM dose 25 mg once daily, PIONEER); masto lines 2817, 2839

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for avapritinib in advanced systemic mastocytosis (ASM/SM-AHN/MCL), a rare myeloid/mast-cell disorder. The advanced-SM avapritinib dose (200 mg PO once daily) is dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Systemic Mastocytosis v3.2026 Discussion MS-18 (PATHFINDER starting dose) and the SM-6 Preferred recommendation; the distinct indolent-SM dose (25 mg once daily, PIONEER) is noted in-drug and deliberately NOT modeled here. BIOMARKER / FALSE-NEGATIVE GUARD: avapritinib targets KIT D816V, the driver of most SM; imatinib is ineffective against D816V (DeVita line 22631) and is reserved for D816V-negative/unknown disease - captured in the biomarkers block so imatinib is not mistakenly substituted. Platelet gate (>= 50 x 10^9/L) for intracranial-bleeding risk is carried as an eligibility criterion and dose-modification rule (SM-6 footnote t). No dose is invented and no field is VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
